targetSpec.description: Optional issue number of a Spec to scope execution strictly to its child tickets

baseBranch.description: The base branch to branch off of and merge PRs into

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel agent worktrees to run simultaneously

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Frequency in seconds to poll GitHub issues

extraPrompt.description: Additional custom instructions or context injected into every agent prompt across the repository (e.g. environment setup, copy untracked .env files, styling rules)

customRunnerCommand.description: Shell command template if runner is set to 'custom'

autoMerge.description: Whether to automatically merge the Pull Request if tests pass

mergeMethod.description: Git merge strategy for Pull Requests

cleanupWorktreeOnClose.description: Whether to automatically delete the worktree and branch once the issue is merged and closed

quota.description: 5-hour rolling quota and rate limit settings

pauseOnLimit.description: Automatically pause active workers when 5h quota is exceeded

proxyPort.description: Port for optional rate-limit interceptor proxy

readyForAgent.description: Label indicating an issue is ready for autonomous agent execution

needsInfo.description: Label indicating agent has paused and requested human feedback

readyForHuman.description: Label indicating issue requires human review or manual intervention

needsTriage.description: Label for newly filed issues awaiting triage
